'''Takan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who was a member of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] cult known as the [[Order of Revan|Revanites]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the War, he lived near [[Kaas City]] on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] along with the rest of his [[Clan Farr|clan]].
